skill.summary: Define, preview, approve, and manage recurring reports for OpenClaw. Use when the user asks for a scheduled report, daily or weekly report, automatic report,...

latestVersion.changelog: Hardened scheduled report approval and delivery flow: previews must be generated and sent inline with the approval request, missing previews must be regenerated/resend instead of repeated as text, chat deliveries now require caption context, preview validation now requires a real artifact file, filename guidance is more human-readable, and workflow docs now clarify schedule ambiguity handling, inbound chat-target defaults, and known host-enforced limitations.
